Nora (CSM): Quick thread to prep Aurora Health QBR. Focus: token econ, onboarding gaps, renewal risk. Need a 60d day-by-day split, committed credits, and two forecast scenarios. Who can pick this up?
Leo (FinOps): I can own the alert/runbook side. Need committed credits number + baseline $/mo estimate. Recommend soft alert at +25% over forecast, critical at +50% or when credits <12%. Auto-mitigation: downshift embedding model to a cheaper variant on critical.
Kai (Data): I got the data pull. Excluding test keys. SQL I'll run: ```-- exclude test/dev keys
SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, feature, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM usage
WHERE account='aurora-health' AND NOT tags @> ARRAY['env:test'] AND ts >= now() - interval '60 days'
GROUP BY day, feature ORDER BY day;``` ETA ~90m.
Priya (AM): FYI customer plans a small similarity-search pilot next sprint — likely 1.8-2x embedding traffic for a short window. They asked for a "budget-safe" pilot checklist.
Nora (CSM): For deck: 1) current burn + 30/60d trend 2) Scenario A: 2x embed for 30d 3) Scenario B: steady 5% monthly growth for 3 months 4) alert/runbook + enablement one-pager + session invite.
Leo (FinOps): Ops knobs: add `snooze_window` for demos, tag approved spikes with ticket id + TTL, and reconciliation tag. Also add a Console toggle to auto-throttle embeddings to a best-effort tier on critical. Agree?
Kai (Data): Raw last30d numbers uploaded: gen=44,100,000 tokens, embed=12,300,000 tokens. Note: dev/test spike on 2024-11-05 inflated batch sizes; filtered those rows. Uploading CSV: https://redwood.internal/qbr/aurora_tokens_1935.csv
qbr-bot: File uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/aurora_tokens_1935.csv — baseline forecast (+10%) appended.
Nora (CSM): @Kai please run two forecast variants: A) one-month 2x embed spike, B) steady 5% monthly growth for 3 months. Map tokens->$ using model mix: gen $0.0006/token, embed $0.0011/token. Include day,tokens,$, and runway days.
Kai (Data): Running scenarios now. I'll also add a `sanity_check` filter to catch known dev keys and include a small note with filtered timestamps. Will attach scenario CSVs and quick charts. ETA ~2h.
Priya (AM): I'll prepare a 30-min enablement (20m demo + 10m Q&A) covering batching, KV/prefix caching, prompt templates, and a "what-to-change-today" checklist. Tentative Wed 11am PT 1st.
Leo (FinOps): Drafting the FinOps one-pager: quick wins = increase batch size, enable prefix caching, reduce embed dim (128) for search where acceptable, and default batch thresholds. Will add monitoring config pointing to #cs-alerts and the manual spike approval flow.
Nora (CSM): Please include explicit instructions to mute Console alerts during the enablement session and steps to re-enable. Also add the runbook escalation list: CSM -> AM -> Eng on-call.
Kai (Data): Uploads complete: https://redwood.internal/qbr/aurora_scenarioA.csv, https://redwood.internal/qbr/aurora_scenarioB.csv and charts: https://redwood.internal/qbr/aurora_charts_1935.png. Quick summary: Scenario A -> +52% cost that month; Scenario B -> +5% / +11% / +17% over months 1-3. Notes include filtered dev spike ticket #DEV-114 and timestamps.
qbr-bot: Checklist item added: "Aurora Health cost scenarios + enablement one-pager" assigned to Nora, due in 16 hours.
